You see a knight armor (Arm:12).
Imbuements: (Empty Slot, Empty Slot).
Classification: 2 Tier: 0.
It can only be wielded properly by knights and paladins.
It weighs 120.00 oz.

    Notes

    Part of the Knight Set. After the Update 8.4, the Knight Armor became for knights and paladins only.

    Paladins are recommended to wear Paladin Armor instead as they save 55 oz of capacity and gain +2 Distance Fighting, but as this is more expensive some choose to use the Knight Armor until they can afford it later.

    Knight Armors can also be obtained by using a Rust Remover on a Rusted Armor or on a Slightly Rusted Armor. Obtainable in the Orc Fortress Quest.
